title: "With Great Power Comes Great Responsibility!": Student and Instructor Perspectives on the influence of LLMs on Undergraduate Engineering Education

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of semi-structured student interviews, capturing qualitative user feedback on the model displaying questionable political affiliations and a lack of impartiality in its responses.

Thematic analysis of semi-structured instructor interviews, documenting apprehensions that the model's training data is heavily skewed toward Western/US contexts and lacks sufficient representation and fairness for users in developing nations like India.
